release_notes: Motor-Only Auto-Cut Architecture: Water full detection triggers only while motor is actively pumping; prevents floating/disconnected sensor wire from latched false Tank Full alerts when motor is OFF.

changelog.notes: Motor-only water sensor detection: sensor only triggers auto-cut while motor is running; 5-min auto reset, reset_tank command, and instant manual start override.
Automatic 5-minute Tank Full warning auto-clear & lockout reset for 2-wire conductive tank probes; manual motor start override enabled.
Morning auto-time schedule and safety presets strictly saved in ESP-01 EEPROM as Single Source of Truth; multi-user clients fetch directly from chip with real-time sync acknowledgement.
Enabled ESP-01S onboard Blue LED on GPIO2 to mirror motor state (Glowing Blue = ON, OFF = STOPPED).
Restored Safe Hi-Z relay driver: High-Impedance INPUT on OFF eliminates optocoupler leakage, solving stuck-on relay issues.
Relocated Float Sensor to GPIO3, retired touch interrupt for 100% crash-free flash boot, and integrated surge barrier protection.
Solid push-pull relay driver (3.3V HIGH when OFF), interrupt decoupling during flash write, 40KB binary reduction for 1MB ESP-01S, and cloud dashboard offline guard.
Solid push-pull relay driver (3.3V HIGH when OFF) to fix stuck-on relay issues on Active-LOW optocoupled modules, plus runtime polarity toggle.
Persistent EEPROM presets, instant water tank level sync, Telegram TLS timeout fix, and electrical transient boot protection.
Customer manual update verification release: Fully verified zero-touch OTA updates with direct streaming.
Verified repeated wireless Over-The-Air firmware flash and instant cloud reconnection.
Live fleet update test: Enhanced TLS handshake headroom and instant state sync.
Verified wireless Over-The-Air update from GitHub Pages with expanded 16KB TLS buffer.
Added persistent non-volatile run cycle logging in EEPROM (Start/Stop triggers, duration, timestamps) with zero flash wear, MQTT cycle telemetry, and weekly usage analytics.
Added autonomous Over-The-Air (OTA) updates from GitHub Pages and remote 1-click fleet trigger without physical buttons.
Direct Hardware Touch ISR (<1us latency) at 160MHz overclock with safe Hi-Z relay driver.
Commercial 50-year zero-cloud architecture with decentralized HiveMQ MQTT and local HTTP portal.
